description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'SQLite' that manages SQLite database operations, including opening, preparing statements, executing queries, loading extensions, and closing the database. It interacts with external modules like 'better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers' and '@streetwriters/kysely'.

classes.name: SQLite
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage SQLite database connections, prepare and execute SQL statements, load extensions, and handle database lifecycle.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the SQLite class and logs a message.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a SQLite database file using 'better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers' in unsafe mode.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with caching and retries on failure.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes a prepared SQL statement, returning query results or affected rows.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs an SQL statement, alias for 'exec'.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and clears prepared statements.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the database file after closing the connection.

methods.name: isDatabaseReady
methods.description: Checks if the database is ready by executing 'SELECT 1'.

methods.name: loadExtensions
methods.description: Loads specific SQLite extensions if not already loaded.
